status: AUTHORED PROVISIONAL INPUTS for the G4-R2 package-closure study (G4_R2_BRIEF.md): owner decisions and answers of 2026-10-17 (verbatim), the in-memory overlay records, labelled catalogue values, authored PROVISIONAL envelopes and grids, pins, and the empty supplier-evidence / lra_supplied / fallback_trigger slots only. No result, margin, verdict, selected design point or minimum diameter is authored here; every result is computed by tools/g4_r2_closure.py.
evidence_policy: Every value carries one evidence class (G4_BRIEF section 6.1). Catalogue values are OWNER_DECISION with catalogue_value true and gate SR-BATT-PACK; they are never MANUFACTURER_VERIFIED. PROVISIONAL_ASSUMPTION values are planning ranges with a rationale and are never supplier, manufacturer, RF, material or MPN data. Frozen G1-R1 values that the project exposes programmatically are read from the pinned sources at run time and are never re-typed here.

architecture_projection.note: Canonical hash (g2_interconnect.dumps) of the read-only projection, identical to the pinned R1 projection.

owner_decisions.verbatim:
- OD-BATTERY: Rev-A battery LPR454440 (870 mAh, Ø44 x 4.5) replaced by
  LPR433736 (585 mAh, 3.7 V, 1C, Ø37 x 4.3 mm, 2.16 Wh), same J201
  connector. Catalogue values pending supplier protected-pack drawing
  (SR-BATT-PACK). If the drawing contradicts the assumed envelope: STOP.
  Fallback LPR403736 (495 mAh, Ø37 x 4.0) only if the caseback
  allowable cannot support LPR433736.

- OD-G4-STACK: zero total Z growth; battery Z saving reallocated to the
  REAR band. OD-THICK-REVA (<= 16.5 mm nominal, <= 17.0 mm RSS)
  unchanged.

- Q-R1-BUTTON-ENVELOPE: proven mechanical buttons: sealed metal pusher
  through the case (stem O-ring or elastomer boot/seal, whichever
  closes), pressing a right-angle side-actuated tactile switch at the
  MAIN board edge; local case bosses <= +3.0 mm (incl. seal and
  tolerance) at the five existing button windows only (10, 9, 8, 2,
  4 o'clock). C-R1-03 ruling not needed. Inductive/force buttons
  deferred to Rev-B. SG: SR-BUTTONS.
- OD-CONN-SIDE: J1501, J201, J202 on MAIN B.Cu; U7 (DRV2625) to B.Cu.

- OD-J202 / Q-R1-CHARGER: J202 on B.Cu toward east; charger contacts on
  the caseback at ~3 o'clock; retire the perimeter conductor band
  except the local charger drop. C-R1-01 2(v) AMENDED to: clear in 3-D,
  i.e. separated in plan OR in Z, with strict 3-D clearance. Record the
  amendment in G4-R2 only; G4_R1_BRIEF.md stays unchanged.

- OD-G4-LRA-ARCH: LRA on MAIN B.Cu in the battery annulus (battery
  offset 0–1.5 mm allowed). Fallback: LRA <= 2.70 mm tall on MAIN F.Cu
  (Z-neutral) if no B.Cu pose exists. Report BMM350 distance.

- Q-R1-MAIN-SEAL: raised, serviceable radial O-ring on a caseback cup.
  Adhesive main seal rejected.

- Q-R1-STRUCTURE / OD-G4-MATERIAL: ceramic (zirconia class) caseback
  cup on the G4-B midcase (metal with dielectric sectors).
- OD-AOD: no always-on display in Rev-A.

- K1-A: authorized in principle, in parallel with G4-R2, under its own
  separate contract (REAR layout + MAIN power-schematic fixes after
  independent verification). Not part of G4-R2.

- OWNER POSITIONS: G5 (antennas) directly after G4-R2; nothing new in
  the reserved GNSS (12), BLE (10–11), Wi-Fi (3:30–4:30) regions. MAIN
  stays shield-ready (§20); shield material decided after Rev-A testing.

open_question_answers.status: DECIDED (first round); "SW1-SW4 stay metal" superseded for SW1 by Q-R2-SW1-BLE
open_question_answers.verbatim:
- Q-R2-SW5-PUSHER: SW5 uses a non-metallic pusher (zirconia or PEEK
  class); SW1–SW4 stay metal. SW5 position unchanged.

- Q-R2-RESERVED-REGION: in the reserved GNSS/BLE/Wi-Fi regions, new
  metal, conductors and components are forbidden. Non-conductive
  structure (ceramic cup ring, dielectric pusher, boss growth) is
  allowed but must be recorded with material, permittivity class and
  volume as a G5 input.

- Q-R2-SHIELD-REF: "§20" means the master handoff's shield-ready policy,
  not a repo file; your architecture.md section A reading is accepted.

open_question_answers.status: SUPERSEDED by Q-R2-K1A correction; recorded for history, never applied
open_question_answers.verbatim:
- Q-R2-K1A: confirmed. K1-A keeps G3-B-S14 REAR placement unchanged and
  is MAIN schematic-only; it moves nothing G4-R2 relies on.

- OD-G4-LRA-MAG: authorized. Report LRA-to-BMM350 distance; magnetometer
  calibration is a later firmware/test item.

- E-1: the rear_sensor .kicad_pro change was KiCad auto-save and has
  been reverted by the owner; keep E-1 as a precondition check.

- Q-R2-SW1-BLE (OQ-1): SW1 uses a non-metallic pusher (zirconia or PEEK
  class), same rule as SW5. SW2, SW3, SW4 keep metal pushers. SW1 window
  and position unchanged. The F-03 lead note is therefore replaced: SW1
  is evaluated like SW5 and is not pre-ordained to R2-S12.

- Q-R2-BOSS-MATERIAL (OQ-2): boss growth inside a reserved region must be
  non-conductive (dielectric sector material or dielectric insert) and is
  recorded as a G5 input. Conductive boss growth inside a reserved region
  is new metal and fails R2-H15. Existing frozen midcase metal is not
  "new".

- Q-R2-K1A correction (OQ-3): the earlier answer "MAIN schematic-only" was
  wrong. Correct scope: K1-A = REAR layout/routing with all G3-B-S14 part
  positions frozen, plus MAIN power-schematic fixes; no MAIN outline,
  placement or routing. It moves nothing G4-R2 relies on.

catalogue.note: Catalogue values recorded from the owner decision of 2026-10-17; pending a supplier protected-pack drawing. Never MANUFACTURER_VERIFIED.

LPR403736.note: Only diameter, thickness and capacity are given by the owner; nothing else is invented.

envelope_assumptions.source: G4_R2_BRIEF.md section 6.2 numeric definition of the "assumed envelope" (R2-S09 trigger)

supplier_evidence_schema.rule: A record counts only with a local primary document (repository path of an existing file that is not a generated or R1 / R2 file) and page plus table / figure provenance. SR-BATT-PACK records are checked against the assumed envelope (R2-S09).

lra_supplied_schema.rule: C-R1-08: a supplied class counts only with a local primary document (repository path, existing file, not an R1 / R2 or generated file) and page plus table / figure provenance; a class defined by the threshold it must meet is rejected.

pcm_admissibility.source: G2 pcm_az_deg 220 / 230 / 240 plus a full-azimuth report

lobe.rationale: Authored adverse envelope of the protection-circuit (PCM) lobe of a finished protected pack: radial protrusion beyond the cell edge (PCM board plus tab fold) and tangential width, both at their maximum at linear worst. Planning values of the same class as the G2 BATT_EXIT sweep; NOT supplier data; the finished-pack drawing (SR-BATT-PACK / SR-BATT-PCM) decides. The lobe Z extent is the pack Z extent.

package_model.rationale: Minimum radial engagement of a case-side support post between the offset carrier outline (plus c_insert) and the case bore; a post shorter than this does not locate the module (G4 H24 / X18 support function).

pusher_dp.stop_rule: largest value whose boss fits the frozen window at the evaluated D

t1_cs.note: dynamic radial window and +/-0.05 mm cross-section tolerance unchanged

zirconia.note: zirconia class: MAT-CERAMIC with PC-CERAMIC-GRIND (17.2 item 22)

PEEK.note: PEEK class: authored polymer process tolerance PC-POLY-MOULD; no PEEK property is invented; strength and stiffness are SUPPLIER_DATA_REQUIRED (SR-BUTTONS) and never credited

buttons.permittivity_policy: A material-family label with its evidence class. No numeric permittivity is invented; a numeric value appears only from a local primary document, otherwise the entry is G5_RF_REQUIRED.

main_seal_cs.rationale: R2-V15: cs 0.5-2.0 mm authorized (a larger cs is a design-size choice; the static radial window and the +/-0.05 mm tolerance are unchanged), diagnostic to 2.5 mm

ring_extra_width_mm.rationale: Inward widening of the raised cup wall beyond the gland-required radial thickness (groove depth + land); coupled to r_lim(cup), reported as a sensitivity

cup.fillet_credit: none (K_t stays at the R1 planning value 2.0)
cup.ring_credit_rule: 100 % only where the ring is continuous over 360 deg at r_ring; any feedthrough or screw interruption gives zero ring stiffness credit (LA-STR-5, continuous-only); no clamped edge is ever assumed
cup.groove_position: groove in the OUTER face of the raised wall; the gland land (material class groove_land_min) lies between the plate top and the groove; wall top = groove top (G4 spigot_height = g + land)
cup.ring_section_z_origin: ring section = wall radial width x [plate bottom, wall top] minus the groove; the plate attaches at the plate mid-plane of the outer region
cup.pressure_on_wall: p_max acts radially inward on the exposed outer face of the wall below the O-ring (plate bottom to the groove land) and adds to the ring hoop stress (reported as a separate component)

bearing.planning_bearing_allowable_source: material sigma_allow_min of MAT-CERAMIC (planning screen, SUPPLIER_GATED SR-CASEBACK-CERAMIC)

cup.case_supports_z: BATTERY level only (the G4 REAR-level extension of the case-side support is not carried: a continuous raised cup wall occupies the REAR-level periphery; BUILDER-INTERPRETATION B-03)

mate_stroke_mm.rationale: Planning insertion / approach stroke of the plug along the mating axis (adverse = max); no connector MPN; SR-FPC-MECH decides

interconnect.fpc_bend_rule: both vertical-riser bends use the adverse planning minimum bend radius R_bend_min(max) (G2 radial parameter, never narrowed)
interconnect.sensor_fpc_width_rule: (positions - 1) x sensor_pitch(max) + 2 x sensor_edge_margin(max), positions from the frozen 24-position interface

j1501.mate: axial toward REAR (fixed lead design rule, G4_R2_BRIEF.md 6.5 / 17.2 item 19)

j201.note: mate direction is a design option; the axial option is evaluated first

j202.note: east sector; window excludes WIFI_RAD, the Wi-Fi region, MAG_CLEAR, SW4 / SW5 bores and the charger wedge features

battery_tail.exit_height_rule: PCM exit at the pack mid-thickness

drop.attachment: FT-C inner face, vertical rise to the J202 plug

u7_lead.note: LRA leads terminate on MAIN B.Cu copper; the lead path is Manhattan on the board, reported only

lra.classes_source: inputs/g4_case_sealing.json lra_classes at their maxima (authored G4 classes) plus lra_supplied
lra.fcu_cap_source: governing front-gap part height (U8 seated max, main_height_map H_F_under_display); Z-neutral binds

paths.tail_hop_note: J1502 tail leaves the REAR level at the frozen exit and enters the lower-web groove (one bend); the foot of the riser is the second bend

slack_pocket.loop: planar U loop: two straight legs and one semicircle of the adverse bend radius
slack_pocket.height_source: G2 service_pocket required_height (t_fpc + c_fpc + collar clearance), conservative corner

battery_tail.exit_point: centre of the outer PCM lobe edge at the pack mid-thickness
battery_tail.plan_run: straight line to the J201 riser

drop.service_open_rule: caseback service position (A10): installed length minus the straight vertical rise must cover the service slack (adverse planning value)

lead_arithmetic.source: section 20 (12.5 x 4.5 + 2 x 0.4, tangential, sagitta about 1.1 at r 21)
